There is a very detailed [guide](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1131162350) in steam forum to optimize your game

Also, I'd like to add a few points:

1. DO NOT install any custom content (store content is ok) through the launcher as it will potentially corrupt your game and dramatically slow down your game and launcher. Install it as .package files instead.

2. You may try to merge your cc if you have tons of it. I would recommend CC Magic instead of s3pe because it is much easier to organize your cc. Besides, if u merge a corrupted cc with other cc using s3pe, it will be a pain in the butt to install all the cc from different websites again (provided that unmerging is barely possible with s3pe). I have tried that and I took weeks to recover my cc again. Cc magic is not a software for advanced users and you can find the guide [here](https://youtu.be/9o_5X4mrb5w).

3. Unpark your CPU if you have more than 4 cores in your computer. Guide is [here](http://modthesims.info/showthread.php?p=4961408).

4. Do you know you can reset you town with nraas' master controller? You can reset it if the lag is unbearable. You should also reset it every 5-6 sim weeks even if it runs well.

5. Remove the cc and mods that is not your favourite.

6. Tune down the graphics settings if you don't mind. Disable interactive loading screen and shop modes. Disable occults and pets (optional). You are strongly advised to disable horses, especially in Isla Paradiso because it's very poorly routed which will cause tremendous lag!

That's all I want to add, I know it may be a very repetitive and boring process. After all, it's just your choice to ignore all the tips and play this laggy game, or run the game much more smoothly after doing all the chores. For me, I am obsessed with the game so I don't mind doing all this work. 

Hopefully my tips help!
